children.name: Hoplestigma klaineanum Pierre
children.description: A rare tree of lowland tropical rainforest in western and central tropical Africa (Gabon, Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Liberia), the type species of the genus Hoplestigma. Placed in the small family Hoplestigmataceae (order Boraginales), it is distinguished by a deeply bifid (cloven) style, and with H. pierreanum is one of only two species in the family.

children.name: Hoplestigma pierreanum Gilg
children.description: Hoplestigma pierreanum is a species of plant in the family Hoplestigmataceae.
